fusions.name: Snapped Spark
fusions.desc: Snaps your fingers, throwing a spark that deals 4 fire damage to the first enemy it meets and sets it [Burning] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hammer on Anvil
fusions.desc: Brings a forge hammer down, dealing 30 fire damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and setting each [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Too Hot to Hold
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn from the Forge
fusions.desc: Conjures a weapon you forged yourself. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
